## TimeRangeField.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The inclusive start and end times as ISO `HH:mm` or `HH:mm:ss`, either of which may be `null`. Bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever the person changes either side of the range.
- `min` :: The earliest selectable ISO time, applied to both sides.
- `max` :: The latest selectable ISO time, applied to both sides.
- `locale` :: BCP 47 locale for segment order, literals and AM/PM labels.
- `granularity` :: How complete each time must be to commit. Hour stores `HH:00`; minute stores `HH:mm`; second stores `HH:mm:ss`.
- `hourCycle` :: 12-hour (with a localized AM/PM segment) or 24-hour clock. Defaults from the locale.
- `placeholder` :: ISO time used when a person first increments an empty segment. Defaults to midnight.
- `size` :: The control height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set. @default 'lg'
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the field. @default 'modern'
- `invalid` :: Marks the field as failing validation: a danger border and `aria-invalid`.
- `readonly` :: Prevents edits; segments remain focusable.
- `disabled` :: Prevents focus and edits.
- `name` :: The name of the hidden inputs (`-start` and `-end` suffixes) that carry the range in a form.
- `variant` :: The frame's visual style: `outline` draws the fill and border, while `ghost` and `secondary` drop the border.
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the dash between the start and the end side. @default 'text-muted'
